_comment: A supracategorisation: every schemaLabel belongs to exactly one of eight families. Families are invariant under the Composer detail zoom -- a node has a family at family, schema, variable and instance level alike -- which is why colour is keyed to this and not to elaboration count or merge depth, both of which move under the viewer. NOT an EIP construct: the scheme was worked out against the EIP schema and the notes below are lifted verbatim from the _family props in eip-schema-cld.json, which carry the argument for each assignment, but it is meant to be used across diagram types. Concepts are keyed spacelessly (ActiveGoal, SideEffect) because sources disagree about the spaces.
_palette: Okabe-Ito with black replaced by violet #6a3d9a and yellow by maroon #96203f. Validated all-pairs on surface #f5f4f1: lightness band PASS, chroma PASS, normal-vision floor PASS (worst 15.6), CVD separation WARN (worst 6.9 deutan, violet/blue) -- inside the 6-8 band, which is legal only alongside secondary encoding. Node labels, the sidebar legend and the family zoom level supply it. Yellow was dropped because no yellow both sits inside the lightness band and stays clear of orange under all-pairs.

ActiveGoal.note: the nearest of the Aims to being acted on.

Affect.note: part of the acting self — what is felt, ahead of what pushes.

Asset.note: accumulated and held by an Institution.

Commitment.note: the end of the conversation chain and the start of acting.

Conversation.note: the head of the chain that ends in Commitment.

Culture.note: a medium, not an institution — Place shapes it and it surrounds Person, as Ecology surrounds Place.

Ecology.note: a medium you are inside, alongside Place and Culture.

Government.note: an organised body. It touches Place the way Org does, from outside.

Ideal.note: something aimed at rather than something that acts.

Motivation.note: inner drive — it pushes rather than being pursued, so it is not an Aim.

Objective.note: aimed at, and unusually, it makes demands.

Org.note: the organised body the rest of this family hangs off.

Place.note: the ground the other two mediums sit on.

Possibility.note: a link in the conversation chain, not something held.

Power.note: accumulated over time and drawn on in order to act.

Problem.note: what is wrong. An input to the system, not a by-product of it.

Purpose.note: the most heavily determined thing aimed at.

Result.note: what comes out. Parent of both the wanted and the unwanted.

Role.note: a slot an organised body creates. A person occupies it; they are not it.

SideEffect.note: unwanted. Shares a parent with Solution but not a family.

Solution.note: yielded by Result, alongside Side Effect.

Trust.note: a link in the conversation chain, not something held.

Value.note: aimed at. The only Aim that creates an Institution.
